lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice contrasting two viewpoints or options with men, däremot, and samtidigt.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Discussing everyday choices where both options have advantages and disadvantages.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik compare two choices for transport, food habits, or free time and point out both advantages and drawbacks.

main_focus.name: simple contrast connectors
main_focus.description: Use men, däremot, and samtidigt to connect a positive point with a limitation or different view.
model_examples: Cykeln är snabbare, men bussen är bekvämare.
Det är billigare. Samtidigt tar det mer tid.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use contrast connectors naturally 4-5 times in the dialogue.

avoid_grammar: advanced concession patterns such as även om and trots att as main focus

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use practical pro/con phrases in short turns, not a formal essay style.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person suggests one option and gives a quick advantage.
dialogue_shape.middle: They contrast it with a drawback or a different advantage of the other option.
dialogue_shape.ending: They decide which compromise is acceptable.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat contrast language with concrete everyday options

focus: the advantage and drawback that matter most

sentence_focus: one sentence with en fördel är att
one sentence with en nackdel är att
